text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I have just wrapped<n>up a training
meeting, when...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Not yet? Ohhh... Come on! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fine and dandy! I'm just waitin' for<n>my folks to
message me back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see their reaction to this<n>video I took. Here,
take a look!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama! Hey, Papa! I wanna<n>introduce y'all to
the very heart of<n>Japan—cherry blossoms! You
see...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The soul of Japan is in these cherry<n>blossom
picnics they have! And I'm<n>'bout to have one right
now! Ain't<n>that right, Fukukitaru? ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hi, Taiki's mama and papa!<n>Come to Japan
and see these lucky<n>flowers for yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't help smilin' when I watch it! I<n>just know
they'll—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, speak of the devil! My papa<n>just messaged
back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Looks like they liked it too! He says,"Your video is so kawaii! Japanesespring looks wonderful! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Your clothes and way of speaking<n>have changed
so much. We could<n>have sworn you were...
Japanese"?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Have I lost touch with my<n>Kentucky
roots?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My folks said I seem Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I mean... I have tried my best to makelots of good memories here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But what if I end up with onlyJapanese memories one day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Am I gonna lose all my memories of<n>back home?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! That would be tragic! I love<n>both Japan and
America! I don't<n>wanna forget either!
choice_data_list: Don't worry. I'm sure you won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... But... apparently I'm like adifferent person than I used to be!
choice_data_list: You're just getting more precious memories.
You're just getting more precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that every new<n>memory she has
gets added to her<n>collection. It doesn't mean she'll
lose<n>her old ones.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So it's like a big album with<n>memories of America
and Japan? Oh,<n>I see... It's like the clothes I was
wearing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I chose the blouse 'cause it matched<n>the cherry
blossoms, and I wore the<n>pants with the stars on
'em 'cause<n>I've always loved stars.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I like these cherry blossom<n>picnics 'cause
they remind me of<n>barbecues back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's like I've... mixed the two<n>memories into one.
Right? That<n>means...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said! I'm not losing<n>memories!
I'm getting new ones! I'm<n>so happy!
choice_data_list: Let's get all sorts of new ones!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said! I'm not losing<n>memories!
I'm getting new ones! I'm<n>so happy!
choice_data_list: Let's get all sorts of new ones!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm sure my folks'll want to<n>see all kinds of
new things that I'm<n>up to!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And what better time than now?! ☆<n>Let's get
filming! You're on camera<n>duty! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, mmm, MMM, that's good!<n>I've been
wanting to try this! And<n>since it's a
limited-time-only cherry<n>blossom flavor, you could
call it the<n>taste of spring! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I got the seat right next to the<n>door! This is
the most popular seat on<n>the train here in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And the last thing I wanna show you...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is Nakayama Racecourse, where<n>the Sprinters
Stakes is held! It's a<n>real barnburner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So many skilled runners race here.<n>And... I'm doin'
my best to win, same<n>as ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually... ever since I came here to<n>Japan and met
my trainer, I've been<n>running better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My memories give me strength... so I<n>wanna make
even more memories<n>and get even better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She announces this passionately into<n>the camera,
clearly burning with even<n>more determination for
her future<n>races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! We're like two happy little<n>peas in a pod! We
gotta get this on<n>video!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: C'mere! Stand right next to me!<n>Ready?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama! Hey, Papa! Me'n Trainer<n>here are
gonna be together forever,<n>happy as can be! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How so? You said you were happy,<n>didn't ya?
...Aaand sent!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That was quick! I already got a<n>reply! It's for
you! And in Japanese<n>to boot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It says... "Dear Trainer. If you and<n>Taiki are happy,
we are happy!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Looks like everyone's<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't be sure if they got the right<n>message, but as
long as Taiki Shuttle<n>seems happy, I suppose it's
okay.
